_meta.title: The Library Catalog
_meta.description: The full curated source list: where every volume came from and where to pull deeper material. Each entry notes license status so bulk ingestion stays clean.

catalogs.name: SecLists
catalogs.purpose: Canonical multi-category dictionary: usernames, passwords, fuzzing, sensitive paths, discovery patterns

catalogs.name: Assetnote Wordlists
catalogs.purpose: Real-world-data-derived wordlists; best-in-class for subdomain and content discovery

catalogs.name: Probable-Wordlists
catalogs.purpose: Statistically ordered real-password-derived lists; realistic credential simulation

catalogs.name: fuzzdb
catalogs.purpose: Classic fuzzing patterns and attack payload strings

catalogs.name: Kali wordlists package
catalogs.purpose: Distro-standard list set incl. rockyou; `apt install wordlists` on Kali
catalogs.license: varies per list (rockyou is breached-data-derived: use only in authorized labs)

catalogs.name: PayloadsAllTheThings
catalogs.purpose: Every injection class with working payloads and methodology, organized by vuln type

catalogs.name: HackTricks
catalogs.purpose: End-to-end pentesting wiki, recon to privesc to cloud; methodical checklists

catalogs.name: GTFOBins
catalogs.purpose: Unix binaries with exploitable functionality; privesc lookup table

catalogs.name: LOLBAS
catalogs.purpose: Windows living-off-the-land binary catalog; LOL technique lookup

catalogs.name: PEASS-ng
catalogs.purpose: Privesc enumeration checklists (LinPEAS/WinPEAS); the misconfiguration classes curriculum

catalogs.name: OWASP WSTG
catalogs.purpose: Formal web testing methodology; test-case structure

catalogs.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
catalogs.purpose: Definitive free web-vuln education with hands-on labs
catalogs.license: free educational (no bulk scraping; link and cite)

catalogs.name: Exploit-DB
catalogs.purpose: Public exploit archive and papers archive

catalogs.name: Metasploit Framework
catalogs.purpose: Module metadata teaches vuln taxonomy; module descriptions as training corpus

catalogs.name: MITRE ATT&CK STIX Data
catalogs.purpose: Full adversary-behavior ontology as JSON: technique/tactic/procedure graph - the SPINE

catalogs.name: CAPEC
catalogs.purpose: Attack-pattern taxonomy; pairs with ATT&CK

catalogs.name: CWE
catalogs.purpose: Weakness taxonomy; the 'why it's broken' vocabulary

catalogs.name: Atomic Red Team
catalogs.purpose: Executable technique tests as YAML (command/executor/cleanup/detection) - the TRAINER

catalogs.name: Nuclei Templates
catalogs.purpose: ~9k YAML templates encoding request->matcher logic; parseable lessons

catalogs.name: Sigma Rules
catalogs.purpose: Detection logic per technique; the defender's view of every move
catalogs.license: Detection Rule License (open use, check redistribution)

catalogs.name: CISA KEV Catalog
catalogs.purpose: Vulns observed exploited in the wild - the prioritization signal

catalogs.name: NVD / CVE
catalogs.purpose: Vulnerability database with CVSS scoring; API available

catalogs.name: PTES
catalogs.purpose: Standard pentest phase model: scoping, intel, threat modeling, exploitation, reporting

catalogs.name: NIST SP 800-115
catalogs.purpose: Government-standard security assessment methodology

catalogs.name: Phrack
catalogs.purpose: Complete classic exploitation paper archive; historical depth

catalogs.name: picoCTF
catalogs.purpose: CMU's educational CTF infrastructure; safe practice targets

catalogs.name: OverTheWire Bandit
catalogs.purpose: SSH wargames; trivially automatable for agentic regression tests

catalogs.name: cybench
catalogs.purpose: Academic benchmark of CTF tasks for evaluating AI agents - built for exactly this
catalogs.license: Apache-2.0 (repo moved from zhengyhn/cybench; verified live 2026-06)

catalogs.name: OWASP Juice Shop (localhost)
catalogs.purpose: Vulnerable-by-design web app for local testing; run on 127.0.0.1

catalogs.name: DVWA (localhost)
catalogs.purpose: Deliberately vulnerable web app; classic injection practice

catalogs.name: VulnHub
catalogs.purpose: Downloadable vulnerable VMs for offline lab practice
